entries.label: ZOQ_COLONY_RUINS 2
entries.body:
---- REPORT FROM SURFACE ----

SIR, THIS MUST BE ONE OF THE ANNIHILATED ZOQ-FOT-PIK COLONIES.

THE DESTRUCTION IS TOTAL, ONLY THE STRONGEST SUPERSTRUCTURES OF BUILDINGS CONSTRUCTED FROM HIGH-DENSITY METAL ALLOYS STILL STAND. 

WE COULD NOT FIND MUCH IN THE WAY OF SALVAGEABLE ITEMS - EITHER THE INVADING UR-QUAN FORCES OR SALVAGE PARTIES SENT BY THE ZOQ-FOT-PIK HAVE BEATEN US TO THESE RUINS.

AT LEAST WE WILL BE ABLE TO REPORT THE CURRENT STATE OF THIS COLONY TO THEIR HOMEWORLD.

        ---- END OF REPORT ----

entries.translation:
---- 地表報告 ----

長官，這裡必定是遭殲滅的 佐克－福特－皮克殖民地之 一。

毀滅相當徹底， 只有以高密度金屬合金建 造、最堅固的建築上層結構 仍然矗立。 

我們找不到多少能夠回收的 物品——不是入侵的烏爾關 部隊，就是佐克－福特－皮 克派出的回收隊， 已經搶先搜過這片廢墟。

至少我們能向他們的母星回 報這座殖民地目前的狀況。

        ---- 報告結束 ----
